origins: Raised in the lightless cellars of the Harrow-Home for Wayward Foundlings
childhoodTraits: learned to predict a strike by watching the shift in a bully’s shoulders
definingMoments: surviving a night in the dog-cages by out-snarling the feral hounds
discovering that a rusted spoon could be sharpened into a deadly shiv in the dark
realizing the arena was the only place where their rage was rewarded with silver
